summary: More reliable private conversations and clearer connector review.

improvements: Follow-up messages can wait safely while your private agent finishes a response.
Connector review identifies the exact tool request before you decide.
fixes: Private chat keeps its conversation context when connector review resumes.
The Files workspace retries temporary cold connection failures without retrying access refusals.
security: First-party owner authorization stays out of third-party connector probes.
Untrusted connector content cannot grant itself access to private information.
